scripts.models:build: npm run models:build:headneck && npm run models:build:upper && npm run models:build:trunk && npm run models:build:lower
scripts.models:build:lower: python3 tools/build_models.py tools/parts-lower.json && gltf-transform meshopt tools/.cache/lower.raw.glb public/models/lower.glb
scripts.models:build:upper: python3 tools/build_models.py tools/parts-upper.json && gltf-transform meshopt tools/.cache/upper.raw.glb public/models/upper.glb
scripts.models:build:trunk: python3 tools/build_models.py tools/parts-trunk.json && gltf-transform meshopt tools/.cache/trunk.raw.glb public/models/trunk.glb
scripts.models:build:headneck: python3 tools/build_models.py tools/parts-headneck.json && gltf-transform meshopt tools/.cache/headneck.raw.glb public/models/headneck.glb
